_help: Edit this file, then run: node scripts/seedChannels.js --admin YOUR_EMAIL  (add --apply to make changes). 'admins' = emails of people who run that channel; they must already have a LASU Connect account. 'postingMode' is 'admins' (only admins post) or 'open' (any signed-in student can post). 'eventCreators' = emails allowed to publish events.
